name: Maggie
description: It is a easy recipe that can be made fast and your tummy gets full😋.
ingredients:
Maggie Packet
Water
Chilli Powder
Turmeric Powder
Salt
Maggie Magic Masala(Optional)
instructions:
1. Boil water in the pan 
2. After you see bubbles are formed add all the masala, salt, etc.
3. After that open the maggie packet and add the noodles and masala.
4. Close the lid of the Pan and let the maggie cook till all the water is gone, if you want soupy noodles you can let the water remain.

ingredients:
Paneer 
Tomatoes 
Onion 
Butter 
Fresh Cream 
Ginger Garlic Paste 
Red Chilli Powder 
Garam Masala 
Salt
Coriander Leaves
instructions:

3. Heat butter and cook the puree.

6. Stir in fresh cream.

name: Veg Fried Rice

Curd
Biryani Masala
Mint

Ghee
Salt

Dosa Batter
Potatoes

name: Pasta Alfredo
description: Creamy Italian white sauce pasta.

Pasta

Cheese

instructions:

name: Chocolate Brownie
description: Soft and fudgy homemade chocolate brownies.
ingredients:
Flour
Cocoa Powder
Butter

Eggs

Vanilla Essence

ingredients:
Lettuce
Croutons
Parmesan Cheese

Mayonnaise

2. Mix dressing.

Chicken Breast

Garlic

instructions:

name: Mango Lassi
description: Refreshing mango smoothie perfect for summer.
ingredients:
Mango
Milk
Sugar
Ice Cubes
instructions:
1. Blend everything.
2. Serve chilled.

name: Vegetable Pizza
description: Homemade pizza topped with fresh vegetables and mozzarella cheese.
ingredients:
Pizza Base
Pizza Sauce
Mozzarella Cheese
Capsicum
Onion

Olives
Oregano
instructions:
1. Spread pizza sauce.
2. Add vegetables.
3. Sprinkle cheese.

name: Chicken Tacos
description: Soft tortillas filled with juicy, seasoned grilled chicken, fresh lettuce, tomatoes, onions, and shredded cheese. Served with salsa and sour cream, these tacos offer the perfect balance of spicy, tangy, and savory flavors, making them a popular Mexican street food enjoyed around the world.
ingredients:
2 Tortillas
250g Chicken Breast
1 Onion
1 Tomato
Lettuce
Cheddar Cheese
Salsa
Sour Cream
Paprika
Cumin Powder
Salt
Olive Oil
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with paprika, cumin, salt, and olive oil.
2. Grill until fully cooked and slice into strips.
3. Warm the tortillas.
4. Fill with chicken, lettuce, tomatoes, onions, and cheese.
5. Top with salsa and sour cream.
6. Fold and serve immediately.

name: Veg Burrito Bowl
description: A wholesome Mexican-inspired bowl made with fluffy rice, black beans, sweet corn, sautéed vegetables, fresh salsa, guacamole, and creamy sour cream. It is nutritious, colorful, and packed with protein and fiber.
ingredients:
Cooked Rice
Black Beans
Sweet Corn
Capsicum
Onion
Tomato
Avocado
Sour Cream
Lettuce
Olive Oil
Mexican Seasoning
instructions:
1. Sauté onions and capsicum.
2. Season vegetables with Mexican spices.
3. Arrange rice in a serving bowl.
4. Add beans, corn, vegetables, lettuce, salsa, and guacamole.
5. Finish with sour cream and serve.

name: Nachos with Cheese
description: Crispy tortilla chips topped with melted cheddar cheese, black beans, jalapeños, olives, and fresh salsa. This delicious appetizer is perfect for parties and can be enjoyed with guacamole and sour cream.
ingredients:
Tortilla Chips
Cheddar Cheese
Black Beans
Jalapeños
Olives
Tomatoes
Onion
Salsa
Sour Cream
instructions:
1. Spread tortilla chips on a baking tray.
2. Add beans, olives, jalapeños, and cheese.
3. Bake until cheese melts.
4. Serve with salsa and sour cream.

name: Grilled Herb Chicken
description: Tender chicken breast marinated with garlic, herbs, olive oil, and lemon juice before being grilled until juicy and lightly charred. Served with roasted vegetables, it is a healthy and flavorful continental main course.
ingredients:
Chicken Breast
Garlic
Olive Oil
Rosemary
Oregano
Lemon Juice
Black Pepper
Salt
Mixed Vegetables
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken for 30 minutes.
2. Grill until golden brown.
3. Roast vegetables separately.
4. Serve chicken with vegetables.

name: Creamy Mushroom Soup
description: A rich and velvety soup prepared with fresh mushrooms, onions, garlic, cream, and vegetable stock. It has a smooth texture and earthy flavor, making it an ideal appetizer during cold weather.
ingredients:
Mushrooms
Butter
Garlic
Onion
Fresh Cream
Vegetable Stock
Black Pepper
Salt
instructions:
1. Sauté mushrooms, onions, and garlic.
2. Add vegetable stock and cook.
3. Blend into a smooth consistency.
4. Stir in cream.
5. Season and serve hot.

name: Baked Mac and Cheese
description: Creamy macaroni coated in a rich cheese sauce and baked until golden with a crispy cheese topping. This comforting continental dish is loved by both children and adults.
ingredients:
Macaroni
Butter
Milk
Cheddar Cheese
Mozzarella Cheese
Flour
Black Pepper
Salt
instructions:
1. Boil macaroni.
2. Prepare cheese sauce.
3. Mix macaroni with sauce.
4. Top with mozzarella.
5. Bake until golden brown.

name: Thai Green Curry
description: A traditional Thai curry prepared with fresh vegetables simmered in aromatic green curry paste and creamy coconut milk. The dish combines spicy, sweet, and savory flavors and is commonly served with steamed jasmine rice.
ingredients:
Green Curry Paste
Coconut Milk
Broccoli
Baby Corn
Carrot
Beans
Basil Leaves
Soy Sauce
Oil
instructions:
1. Fry green curry paste.
2. Add coconut milk.
3. Add vegetables.
4. Simmer until vegetables are tender.
5. Garnish with basil leaves.

name: Pad Thai Noodles
description: Thailand's famous stir-fried noodle dish made with rice noodles, vegetables, bean sprouts, peanuts, and a flavorful sweet-and-tangy sauce. It is light, aromatic, and packed with authentic Thai flavors.
ingredients:
Rice Noodles
Bean Sprouts
Spring Onion
Carrot
Peanuts
Soy Sauce
Tamarind Sauce
Garlic
Egg (Optional)
Oil
instructions:
1. Soak rice noodles.
2. Stir fry garlic and vegetables.
3. Add noodles and sauces.
4. Toss well.
5. Garnish with peanuts and spring onions.

name: Thai Basil Chicken
description: A classic Thai stir-fry featuring tender chicken cooked with garlic, fresh basil leaves, chilies, and savory sauces. It is fragrant, mildly spicy, and traditionally served over steamed jasmine rice.
ingredients:
Chicken
Garlic
Thai Basil
Green Chilli
Soy Sauce
Oyster Sauce
Sugar
Oil
Jasmine Rice
instructions:
1. Stir fry garlic and chilli.
2. Add chicken and cook thoroughly.
3. Add sauces and sugar.
4. Stir in basil leaves.
5. Serve with steamed jasmine rice.

name: Matar Paneer
description: Matar Paneer is a classic North Indian curry made with soft paneer cubes and sweet green peas simmered in a rich onion-tomato gravy flavored with aromatic Indian spices. This comforting vegetarian dish pairs perfectly with naan, roti, or steamed basmati rice and is ideal for family lunches and dinners.
ingredients: Paneer, Green Peas, Onion, Tomato, Ginger-Garlic Paste, Green Chilli, Cooking Oil, Butter, Cumin Seeds, Bay Leaf, Turmeric Powder, Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder, Coriander Powder, Cumin Powder, Garam Masala, Kasuri Methi, Fresh Cream, Water, Salt, Fresh Coriander
instructions:
1. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil and 1 tbsp butter in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add ½ tsp cumin seeds and 1 bay leaf. Cook for 20 seconds until fragrant.
3. Add 2 finely chopped onions and sauté for 6–8 minutes until golden brown.
4. Add 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste and 2 slit green chillies. Cook for 1 minute.
5. Add puree of 3 tomatoes and cook for 8–10 minutes until the oil separates.
6. Add ½ tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp Kashmiri red chilli powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin powder, and salt to taste. Cook for 2 minutes.
7. Add 1 cup green peas and 1 cup water. Cover and cook for 8 minutes.
8. Add 250 g paneer cubes and gently mix.
9. Stir in ½ cup fresh cream, 1 tsp garam masala, and 1 tsp crushed kasuri methi.
10. Simmer for 5 minutes.
11. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with naan, roti, or steamed rice.

name: Pav Bhaji
description: Pav Bhaji is Mumbai's iconic street food consisting of mashed mixed vegetables cooked in butter with aromatic spices and served alongside buttery toasted pav. It is rich, spicy, flavorful, and loved by people of all ages.
ingredients: Potato, Cauliflower, Green Peas, Carrot, Capsicum, Onion, Tomato, Ginger-Garlic Paste, Butter, Cooking Oil, Pav Bhaji Masala, Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder, Turmeric Powder, Salt, Fresh Coriander, Lemon, Pav
instructions:
1. Boil 2 potatoes, 1 cup cauliflower florets, ½ cup green peas, and 1 chopped carrot until soft.
2. Mash all the vegetables thoroughly.
3. Heat 2 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp oil in a large pan.
4. Add 2 finely chopped onions and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Add 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
6. Add 2 chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
7. Add ¼ tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp Kashmiri red chilli powder, 2 tsp pav bhaji masala, and salt to taste.
8. Cook the masala for 2–3 minutes.
9. Add the mashed vegetables and 2 cups water. Mix well.
10. Cook for 12–15 minutes while mashing occasionally.
11. Add 1 tbsp butter and chopped coriander before serving.
12. Toast the pav with butter until golden brown and serve with chopped onions and lemon wedges.

name: Misal Pav
description: Misal Pav is a famous Maharashtrian delicacy made with spicy sprouted moth bean curry topped with crunchy farsan, chopped onions, coriander, and lemon juice. It is a flavorful breakfast or brunch dish known for its spicy and tangy taste.
ingredients: Sprouted Moth Beans, Onion, Tomato, Ginger-Garlic Paste, Cooking Oil, Mustard Seeds, Cumin Seeds, Curry Leaves, Turmeric Powder, Red Chilli Powder, Coriander Powder, Goda Masala, Salt, Water, Farsan, Fresh Coriander, Lemon, Pav
instructions:
1. Soak 2 cups of moth beans overnight and allow them to sprout for 24 hours, or use ready-made sprouts.
2. Pressure cook the sprouts with 2 cups of water for 3 whistles until soft.
3. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a deep pan over medium heat.
4. Add 1 tsp mustard seeds and let them crackle. Then add ½ tsp cumin seeds and 8–10 curry leaves.
5. Add 2 finely chopped onions and sauté for 5–6 minutes until golden brown.
6. Add 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
7. Add 2 finely chopped tomatoes and cook until they become soft and the oil starts separating.
8. Mix in ¼ tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, 2 tsp goda masala, and salt to taste. Cook for 2–3 minutes.
9. Add the cooked sprouts along with their cooking water and another 1 cup of water. Mix well.
10. Simmer the curry for 15 minutes so the flavors blend together.
11. Pour the curry into a serving bowl and top generously with farsan, chopped onions, fresh coriander, and lemon juice.
12. Serve hot with butter-toasted pav.

name: Chole Bhature
description: Chole Bhature is one of North India's most popular dishes, featuring fluffy deep-fried bhature served with spicy chickpea curry. The chickpeas are slow-cooked in a flavorful onion-tomato gravy with aromatic spices, making it a hearty and satisfying meal.
ingredients: Chickpeas, Onion, Tomato, Ginger-Garlic Paste, Cooking Oil, Cumin Seeds, Bay Leaf, Turmeric Powder, Red Chilli Powder, Coriander Powder, Cumin Powder, Chole Masala, Garam Masala, Salt, Fresh Coriander, Black Tea Bag, All-Purpose Flour, Curd, Baking Soda, Sugar, Water
instructions:
1. Soak 2 cups of chickpeas overnight in enough water.
2. Pressure cook the chickpeas with fresh water, 1 black tea bag (optional), and 1 tsp salt for 5–6 whistles until tender. Remove the tea bag.
3. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a pan.
4. Add 1 tsp cumin seeds and 1 bay leaf. Sauté for 30 seconds.
5. Add 2 finely chopped onions and cook for 6–8 minutes until golden brown.
6. Add 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
7. Add puree of 3 tomatoes and cook until the oil separates.
8. Add ½ tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp coriander powder, 1 tsp cumin powder, 2 tsp chole masala, and salt to taste. Cook the masala for 3 minutes.
9. Add the cooked chickpeas along with 1 cup of the cooking water. Mix well and simmer for 20 minutes.
10. Finish with 1 tsp garam masala and chopped coriander leaves.

For Bhature:
11. In a bowl, mix 2 cups all-purpose flour, ½ cup curd, ½ tsp baking soda, 1 tsp sugar, ½ tsp salt, and 1 tbsp oil.
12. Add warm water little by little and knead into a soft dough.
13. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours.
14. Divide the dough into equal portions and roll into oval discs.
15. Heat oil for deep frying and fry each bhatura until puffed and golden on both sides.
16. Serve hot with chole, sliced onions, lemon wedges, and pickle.

name: Kanda Poha
description: Kanda Poha is a light and flavorful Maharashtrian breakfast prepared with flattened rice, onions, peanuts, curry leaves, and mild spices. It is quick to prepare, easy to digest, and traditionally garnished with fresh coriander, grated coconut, and lemon juice for a refreshing finish.
ingredients: Poha, Onion, Green Chilli, Peanuts, Cooking Oil, Mustard Seeds, Cumin Seeds, Curry Leaves, Turmeric Powder, Sugar, Salt, Fresh Coriander, Fresh Coconut, Lemon
instructions:
1. Place 2 cups of thick poha in a sieve and rinse gently under running water for 20–30 seconds. Let it rest for 5 minutes until soft.
2. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add ¼ cup peanuts and roast them for 2–3 minutes until crisp. Remove and keep aside.
4. In the same pan, add 1 tsp mustard seeds and allow them to crackle.
5. Add ½ tsp cumin seeds and 8–10 curry leaves. Sauté for 30 seconds.
6. Add 2 finely chopped onions and 2 chopped green chillies. Cook for 4–5 minutes until the onions become soft.
7. Add ¼ tsp turmeric powder, 1 tsp sugar, and salt to taste. Mix well.
8. Add the softened poha and gently fold everything together so the flakes do not break.
9. Cook on low heat for 3–4 minutes while stirring gently.
10. Add the roasted peanuts and mix once.
11. Turn off the heat and garnish with 2 tbsp chopped coriander, 2 tbsp freshly grated coconut, and juice of half a lemon.
12. Serve hot with tea or coffee.

name: Italian Frittata
description: Italian Frittata is a thick, fluffy egg dish loaded with vegetables, cheese, and herbs. Unlike an omelet, the fillings are mixed into the eggs before cooking. It is a classic Italian breakfast that's healthy, filling, and easy for beginners.
ingredients:
Eggs
Milk
Onion
Bell pepper
Tomato
Spinach
Parmesan cheese
Olive oil
Salt
Black pepper
Italian seasoning
Fresh basil
instructions:
1. Crack 4 eggs into a bowl and add 2 tablespoons milk. Whisk until smooth and slightly frothy.

2. Add ½ teaspoon salt, ¼ teaspoon black pepper, and ½ teaspoon Italian seasoning. Mix well.

3. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.

4. Add ½ cup chopped onion and cook for 2 minutes until soft.

5. Add ½ cup chopped bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes.

6. Add ½ cup chopped tomato and 1 cup chopped spinach. Cook for 2–3 minutes until the spinach wilts and excess moisture evaporates.

7. Pour the egg mixture evenly over the vegetables.

8. Sprinkle ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese on top.

9. Cook on low heat for 6–8 minutes without stirring until the bottom is set.

10. Cover with a lid for 2–3 minutes so the top cooks completely.

11. Garnish with 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil.

12. Slice and serve hot.

name: Bruschetta with Tomato and Basil
description: Bruschetta is toasted Italian bread topped with juicy tomatoes, basil, garlic, and olive oil. It is light, fresh, and perfect for a quick breakfast.
ingredients:
Bread
Tomato
Garlic
Fresh basil
Olive oil
Salt
Black pepper
instructions:
1. Slice 4 pieces of bread about 1 inch thick.

2. Toast the bread until golden and crisp on both sides.

3. Finely chop 2 medium tomatoes and place them in a bowl.

4. Add 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil.

5. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil, ¼ teaspoon salt, and ¼ teaspoon black pepper. Mix gently.

6. Peel 1 garlic clove and rub it over the warm toasted bread.

7. Spoon the tomato mixture generously onto each slice.

8. Drizzle 1 teaspoon olive oil over each slice before serving.

9. Serve immediately while the bread is crisp.

name: Italian Ricotta Toast with Honey and Fruits
description: Ricotta Toast is a creamy and refreshing Italian breakfast made with ricotta cheese, fresh fruits, and a drizzle of honey. It is nutritious, colorful, and takes only a few minutes to prepare.
ingredients:
Bread
Ricotta cheese
Honey
Strawberries
Blueberries
Banana
Mint leaves
instructions:
1. Toast 2 slices of bread until lightly crisp.

2. Spread ½ cup ricotta cheese evenly over both slices.

3. Slice 4 strawberries and ½ banana into thin pieces.

4. Arrange the strawberries, banana slices, and ¼ cup blueberries on top.

5. Drizzle 2 teaspoons honey evenly over the fruit.

6. Garnish with 1 tablespoon chopped mint leaves.

7. Serve immediately.

name: Cornetto with Chocolate Filling
description: Cornetto is the Italian version of a croissant. It is soft, buttery, and commonly enjoyed with coffee for breakfast. This version uses a chocolate filling.
ingredients:
Puff pastry
Chocolate spread
Egg
Milk
Powdered sugar
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 200°C.

2. Roll out 1 sheet of puff pastry and cut it into 6 triangles.

3. Place 1 tablespoon chocolate spread at the wider end of each triangle.

4. Roll each triangle tightly toward the pointed end to form a crescent shape.

5. Beat 1 egg with 1 tablespoon milk.

6. Brush the egg mixture over each pastry.

7. Bake for 15–18 minutes until golden brown.

8. Let cool for 5 minutes.

9. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon powdered sugar over the pastries before serving.

name: Italian Breakfast Polenta
description: Italian Breakfast Polenta is a creamy cornmeal porridge traditionally enjoyed warm. It can be served with cheese and herbs for a savory breakfast that is both comforting and satisfying.
ingredients:
Polenta
Water
Milk
Butter
Parmesan cheese
Salt
Black pepper
Fresh parsley
instructions:
1. Bring 2 cups water and 1 cup milk to a gentle boil in a saucepan.

2. Add ½ teaspoon salt.

3. Slowly add ½ cup polenta, whisking continuously to prevent lumps.

4. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 18–20 minutes, stirring frequently until thick and creamy.

5. Add 1 tablespoon butter and stir until melted.

6. Mix in ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese.

7. Add ¼ teaspoon black pepper and stir well.

8. Garnish with 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley.

9. Serve warm.

name: Vegetable Hakka Noodles
description: Vegetable Hakka Noodles are stir-fried noodles tossed with crunchy vegetables, garlic, soy sauce, and mild seasonings. This popular Indo-Chinese dish is flavorful, satisfying, and ideal for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: Hakka Noodles, Cabbage, Carrot, Capsicum, Spring Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Soy Sauce, Vinegar, White Pepper Powder, Salt, Cooking Oil, Sesame Oil
instructions:
1. Cook 2 cups of rice and allow it to cool completely. Cold rice works best for fried rice.

2. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.

3. Add 1 tbsp finely chopped garlic and 1 tsp finely chopped ginger. Stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.

4. Add ½ cup chopped carrot, ½ cup chopped French beans, and ½ cup green peas. Stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until slightly tender but still crunchy.

5. Add the cooked rice and gently toss everything together.

6. Pour in 2 tbsp soy sauce, add ¼ tsp white pepper powder, and salt to taste.

7. Stir-fry for another 2–3 minutes until the rice is evenly coated.

8. Add 2 tbsp chopped spring onion and 1 tsp sesame oil.

9. Toss well and serve hot.

name: Vegetable Manchurian with Gravy
description: Vegetable Manchurian is made with crispy vegetable balls cooked in a flavorful soy-based gravy. It is one of the most loved Indo-Chinese dishes and pairs perfectly with fried rice or noodles.
ingredients: Cabbage, Carrot, Capsicum, Spring Onion, Corn Flour, All-Purpose Flour, Ginger, Garlic, Soy Sauce, Tomato Ketchup, Red Chilli Sauce, Vinegar, Black Pepper Powder, Salt, Cooking Oil, Water
instructions:
1. Cut 250 g tofu into cubes.

2. Coat the tofu with 2 tbsp corn flour and a pinch of salt.

3. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil and fry the tofu until golden. Remove and keep aside.

4. In the same pan, add 1 tbsp chopped garlic, 1 tsp chopped ginger, and 4 dry red chillies. Stir-fry for 30 seconds.

5. Add 1 sliced onion and 1 sliced capsicum. Cook for 3 minutes.

6. Add ¼ cup roasted peanuts.

7. Pour in 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp vinegar, and 1 tsp sugar.

8. Add ¼ cup water and simmer for 2 minutes.

9. Add the fried tofu and toss gently until coated.

10. Drizzle 1 tsp sesame oil and garnish with 2 tbsp chopped spring onion.

11. Serve hot with steamed rice.

name: Sweet and Sour Vegetables
description: Sweet and Sour Vegetables is a colorful Chinese dish made with crispy vegetables coated in a tangy, mildly sweet sauce. It is a delicious accompaniment to steamed rice or noodles.
ingredients:
Capsicum
Onion
Carrot
Pineapple
Garlic
Ginger
Corn Flour
Soy Sauce
Tomato Ketchup
Vinegar
Sugar
Salt
Cooking Oil
Spring Onion
instructions:
1. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wok over high heat.

2. Add 1 tbsp chopped garlic and 1 tsp chopped ginger. Stir-fry for 30 seconds.

3. Add 1 cup chopped capsicum, 1 cup onion cubes, and ½ cup sliced carrot. Cook for 4 minutes.

4. Add ½ cup pineapple chunks.

5. In a bowl, mix 2 tbsp tomato ketchup, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp vinegar, and 1 tbsp sugar.

6. Pour the sauce into the pan and mix well.

7. Add ½ cup water and bring to a gentle boil.

8. Mix 1 tbsp corn flour with 2 tbsp water and pour into the sauce while stirring continuously.

9. Add salt to taste and cook for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens.

10. Garnish with 2 tbsp chopped spring onion.

11. Serve hot with fried rice or noodles.

name: Beef Wellington
description: Beef Wellington is a luxurious British dish made by wrapping tender beef fillet in a flavorful mushroom duxelles and puff pastry before baking until golden. It is known for its crisp pastry exterior and juicy, perfectly cooked beef.
ingredients:
Beef Tenderloin
Mushrooms
Onion
Garlic
Butter
Olive Oil
Dijon Mustard
Puff Pastry
Egg
Salt
Black Pepper
Fresh Thyme
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 200°C.

2. Season 500 g beef tenderloin with 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper.

3. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan and sear the beef for 1–2 minutes on each side. Remove and allow it to cool.

4. Brush the beef with 2 tbsp Dijon mustard while still warm.

5. Finely chop 300 g mushrooms, 1 small onion, and 2 garlic cloves.

6. Melt 2 tbsp butter in a pan and cook the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.

7. Add the mushrooms and 1 tsp chopped fresh thyme. Cook for 10–12 minutes until all moisture evaporates.

8. Allow the mushroom mixture to cool completely.

9. Roll out 1 sheet of puff pastry and spread the mushroom mixture evenly over it.

10. Place the beef in the center and wrap it tightly with the pastry.

11. Beat 1 egg and brush it over the pastry.

12. Bake for 35–40 minutes until the pastry is golden brown.

13. Rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

name: Peking Duck
description: Peking Duck is a famous Chinese delicacy featuring crispy roasted duck with thin pancakes, fresh vegetables, and sweet hoisin sauce. It is renowned for its crispy skin and tender meat.
ingredients:
Whole Duck
Honey
Soy Sauce
Rice Vinegar
Five Spice Powder
Garlic
Ginger
Salt
Spring Onion
Cucumber
Hoisin Sauce
Chinese Pancakes
instructions:
1. Clean a 2 kg whole duck thoroughly and pat it dry.

2. Rub 2 tsp salt and 2 tsp five spice powder all over the duck.

3. Mix 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy sauce, and 1 tbsp rice vinegar.

4. Brush the glaze evenly over the duck.

5. Refrigerate the duck uncovered for 12–24 hours to dry the skin.

6. Preheat the oven to 190°C.

7. Roast the duck for 90 minutes, brushing with glaze every 30 minutes.

8. Increase the oven temperature to 220°C and roast for another 15 minutes for crispy skin.

9. Allow the duck to rest for 15 minutes.

10. Slice thinly and serve with pancakes, cucumber, spring onion, and hoisin sauce.

name: Lasagna
description: Lasagna is a traditional Italian baked pasta dish made by layering pasta sheets with rich meat sauce, creamy béchamel sauce, and cheese before baking until golden and bubbly.
ingredients:
Lasagna Sheets
Minced Meat
Onion
Garlic
Tomato Puree
Olive Oil
Butter
All-Purpose Flour
Milk
Mozzarella Cheese
Parmesan Cheese
Italian Seasoning
Salt
Black Pepper
instructions:
1. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan.

2. Cook 1 chopped onion and 2 chopped garlic cloves for 3 minutes.

3. Add 500 g minced meat and cook until browned.

4. Stir in 2 cups tomato puree, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 20 minutes.

5. In another pan, melt 2 tbsp butter.

6. Add 2 tbsp all-purpose flour and cook for 1 minute.

7. Slowly whisk in 2 cups milk and cook until thick.

8. Grease a baking dish and spread a little meat sauce.

9. Arrange lasagna sheets, meat sauce, béchamel sauce, and mozzarella cheese.

10. Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used.

11. Sprinkle ½ cup Parmesan cheese on top.

12. Bake at 180°C for 40–45 minutes.

13. Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Paella Valenciana
description: Paella Valenciana is a traditional Spanish rice dish prepared with saffron-infused rice, vegetables, chicken, and seafood. It is cooked in a wide pan to develop its signature texture and rich flavor.
ingredients:
Basmati Rice
Chicken
Shrimp
Green Beans
Bell Pepper
Tomato
Onion
Garlic
Olive Oil
Saffron
Paprika
Chicken Stock
Salt
Black Pepper
Parsley
Lemon
instructions:
1. Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a large paella pan.

2. Cook 300 g chicken pieces for 8–10 minutes until browned.

3. Add 200 g shrimp and cook for 2 minutes. Remove and keep aside.

4. Add 1 chopped onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chopped tomato, 1 sliced bell pepper, and 1 cup green beans. Cook for 5 minutes.

5. Stir in 2 cups rice and 1 tsp paprika.

6. Add a pinch of saffron dissolved in 3 cups warm chicken stock.

7. Return the chicken and shrimp to the pan.

8. Cook uncovered over medium heat for 20–25 minutes without stirring.

9. Allow the rice to rest for 10 minutes.

10. Garnish with chopped parsley and lemon wedges before serving.

name: Ramen
description: Ramen is a traditional Japanese noodle soup featuring rich, slow-cooked broth, springy noodles, marinated eggs, tender sliced pork, and fresh vegetables. It is one of Japan's most iconic comfort foods and requires several components prepared separately before assembling.
ingredients:
Ramen Noodles
Chicken Bones
Pork Belly
Eggs
Soy Sauce
Miso Paste
Garlic
Ginger
Spring Onion
Mushrooms
Nori Sheets
Sesame Oil
Chicken Stock
Salt
Black Pepper
instructions:
1. Add 1 kg chicken bones and 2 liters water to a large pot and bring to a boil.

2. Add 5 garlic cloves, 2 inches sliced ginger, and simmer for 3–4 hours.

3. In another bowl, mix ¼ cup soy sauce and 2 tbsp water. Place 4 boiled eggs in the mixture and marinate for at least 4 hours.

4. Cook 300 g pork belly in a pan until browned, then slice thinly.

5. Add 2 tbsp miso paste and 2 tbsp soy sauce to the broth. Stir until dissolved.

6. Cook 300 g ramen noodles according to the package instructions.

7. Divide the noodles among serving bowls.

8. Pour the hot broth over the noodles.

9. Top with sliced pork, halved marinated eggs, mushrooms, spring onion, and nori sheets.

10. Drizzle 1 tsp sesame oil over each bowl and serve immediately.

name: Coq au Vin
description: Coq au Vin is a traditional French dish where chicken is slowly braised in red wine with mushrooms, onions, and herbs, creating a rich and deeply flavorful stew.
ingredients:
Chicken
Red Wine
Mushrooms
Onion
Garlic
Butter
Olive Oil
Carrot
Chicken Stock
Tomato Paste
Fresh Thyme
Bay Leaf
Salt
Black Pepper
Parsley
instructions:
1. Season 1 kg chicken pieces with 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper.

2. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large pot.

3. Brown the chicken on all sides for about 8 minutes. Remove and keep aside.

4. Add 2 chopped onions, 2 sliced carrots, and 3 chopped garlic cloves. Cook for 5 minutes.

5. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste.

6. Pour in 2 cups red wine and 1 cup chicken stock.

7. Add the chicken back to the pot along with 1 bay leaf and 2 sprigs fresh thyme.

8. Cover and simmer for 1½ hours.

9. Add 250 g mushrooms and cook for another 20 minutes.

10. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

name: Moussaka
description: Moussaka is a famous Greek baked casserole made with layers of eggplant, potatoes, seasoned minced meat, and creamy béchamel sauce. It is rich, hearty, and perfect for special occasions.
ingredients:
Eggplant
Potato
Minced Lamb
Onion
Garlic
Tomato Puree
Olive Oil
Butter
All-Purpose Flour
Milk
Egg
Parmesan Cheese
Nutmeg
Salt
Black Pepper
instructions:
1. Slice 2 eggplants and 2 potatoes into thin rounds.

2. Brush with 2 tbsp olive oil and roast at 200°C for 25 minutes.

3. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan.

4. Cook 1 chopped onion and 3 garlic cloves for 3 minutes.

5. Add 500 g minced lamb and cook until browned.

6. Stir in 2 cups tomato puree, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 20 minutes.

7. Melt 2 tbsp butter, add 2 tbsp all-purpose flour, then slowly whisk in 2 cups milk.

8. Add 1 beaten egg, ½ cup Parmesan cheese, and a pinch of nutmeg.

9. Layer potatoes, eggplant, meat sauce, and béchamel sauce in a baking dish.

10. Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes until golden.

11. Cool for 15 minutes before serving.

name: Mole Poblano
description: Mole Poblano is a traditional Mexican dish featuring chicken served with a rich sauce made from dried chilies, chocolate, nuts, spices, and tomatoes. It is one of Mexico's most celebrated and complex recipes.
ingredients:
Chicken
Dried Ancho Chillies
Dried Pasilla Chillies
Tomato
Onion
Garlic
Almonds
Peanuts
Sesame Seeds
Dark Chocolate
Cinnamon
Cloves
Chicken Stock
Cooking Oil
Salt
instructions:
1. Toast 4 dried ancho chillies and 3 dried pasilla chillies for 2 minutes.

2. Soak the chillies in hot water for 20 minutes.

3. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil and cook 1 chopped onion, 4 garlic cloves, and 2 chopped tomatoes until soft.

4. Blend the soaked chillies, vegetables, ¼ cup almonds, ¼ cup peanuts, 2 tbsp sesame seeds, 30 g dark chocolate, ½ tsp cinnamon, and 2 cloves into a smooth paste.

5. Heat 2 tbsp oil and cook the paste for 10 minutes.

6. Add 2 cups chicken stock and simmer for 30 minutes.

7. Cook 1 kg chicken separately until tender.

8. Add the cooked chicken to the mole sauce and simmer for another 15 minutes.

9. Serve hot with rice or tortillas.

name: Sushi Platter
description: A Sushi Platter is a traditional Japanese meal consisting of assorted sushi rolls and nigiri prepared with seasoned sushi rice, fresh seafood, vegetables, and seaweed. It requires precision and careful preparation for the best results.
ingredients:
Sushi Rice
Rice Vinegar
Sugar
Salt
Nori Sheets
Salmon
Tuna
Cucumber
Avocado
Crab Sticks
Soy Sauce
Wasabi
Pickled Ginger
instructions:
1. Cook 2 cups sushi rice and allow it to cool slightly.

2. Mix 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 2 tbsp sugar, and 1 tsp salt until dissolved.

3. Fold the vinegar mixture gently into the rice.

4. Place a nori sheet on a bamboo rolling mat.

5. Spread a thin layer of sushi rice evenly over the nori.

6. Arrange slices of salmon, cucumber, avocado, or crab sticks along one edge.

7. Roll tightly using the bamboo mat.

8. Slice each roll into 8 equal pieces using a wet sharp knife.

9. For nigiri, shape small portions of rice by hand and place slices of salmon or tuna on top.

10. Arrange all sushi neatly on a serving platter with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

name: Garlic Bread
description: Garlic Bread is a crispy and buttery Italian snack made by toasting bread with a flavorful garlic butter spread. It is crunchy on the outside, soft on the inside, and perfect as a quick appetizer or evening snack.
ingredients:
French Bread
Butter
Garlic
Parsley
Mozzarella Cheese
Salt
Black Pepper
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 180°C.

2. Slice 1 loaf of French bread into thick pieces without cutting all the way through.

3. Mix 100 g softened butter, 5 minced garlic cloves, 2 tbsp chopped parsley, ¼ tsp salt, and ¼ tsp black pepper.

4. Spread the garlic butter generously between each slice.

5. Sprinkle 1 cup grated mozzarella cheese over the bread.

6. Wrap the bread loosely in aluminum foil.

7. Bake for 15 minutes.

8. Remove the foil and bake for another 5 minutes until the cheese is melted and lightly golden.

9. Slice and serve hot.

name: Spring Rolls
description: Spring Rolls are crispy Chinese snacks filled with stir-fried vegetables wrapped in thin pastry sheets and deep-fried until golden brown. They are commonly served with sweet chili sauce.
ingredients:
Spring Roll Wrappers
Cabbage
Carrot
Capsicum
Spring Onion
Garlic
Soy Sauce
Corn Flour
Water
Salt
Black Pepper
Cooking Oil
instructions:
1. Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a pan.

2. Add 1 tbsp chopped garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.

3. Add 1 cup shredded cabbage, ½ cup grated carrot, ½ cup sliced capsicum, and ¼ cup chopped spring onion.

4. Stir-fry the vegetables for 4 minutes.

5. Add 1 tbsp soy sauce, ¼ tsp black pepper, and salt to taste.

6. Mix 2 tbsp corn flour with 3 tbsp water to prepare a sealing paste.

7. Place 2 tbsp filling on each spring roll wrapper and roll tightly.

8. Seal the edges with the corn flour paste.

9. Heat enough cooking oil for deep frying.

10. Fry the spring rolls until golden brown and crispy.

11. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

name: Mozzarella Cheese Sticks
description: Mozzarella Cheese Sticks are crispy on the outside and filled with gooey melted cheese inside. They are a popular snack served with marinara or tomato sauce.
ingredients:
Mozzarella Cheese
All-Purpose Flour
Egg
Bread Crumbs
Italian Seasoning
Salt
Black Pepper
Cooking Oil
instructions:
1. Cut 250 g mozzarella cheese into thick stick-shaped pieces.

2. Beat 2 eggs in a bowl.

3. In another bowl, mix 1 cup bread crumbs, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, ¼ tsp salt, and ¼ tsp black pepper.

4. Coat each cheese stick in ½ cup all-purpose flour.

5. Dip it into the beaten egg.

6. Roll it in the breadcrumb mixture.

7. Repeat the egg and breadcrumb coating once more.

8. Freeze the coated cheese sticks for 1 hour.

9. Heat cooking oil to medium-high heat.

10. Fry the cheese sticks for 1–2 minutes until golden brown.

11. Serve immediately with tomato sauce.

name: Veg Momos
description: Veg Momos are soft steamed dumplings filled with finely chopped vegetables and mild seasonings. They are a popular Tibetan snack enjoyed with spicy red chutney.
ingredients:
All-Purpose Flour
Cabbage
Carrot
Spring Onion
Garlic
Ginger
Soy Sauce
Salt
Black Pepper
Cooking Oil
Water
instructions:
1. Mix 2 cups all-purpose flour with ¾ cup water and knead into a smooth dough. Rest for 30 minutes.

2. Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a pan.

3. Add 1 tbsp chopped garlic and 1 tsp chopped ginger.

4. Add 1 cup shredded cabbage, ½ cup grated carrot, and ¼ cup chopped spring onion.

5. Stir-fry for 4 minutes.

6. Add 1 tbsp soy sauce, salt, and ¼ tsp black pepper.

7. Roll the dough into small thin circles.

8. Place 1 tbsp filling in the center of each wrapper.

9. Fold and seal the edges carefully.

10. Steam the momos for 12–15 minutes.

11. Serve hot with spicy momo chutney.

name: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Chocolate Lava Cake is a rich and indulgent dessert with a soft chocolate cake exterior and a warm, gooey molten chocolate center. It is best served fresh from the oven with ice cream or whipped cream.
ingredients:
Dark Chocolate
Butter
Eggs
Sugar
All-Purpose Flour
Vanilla Extract
Salt
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 200°C.

2. Grease 4 ramekins with butter and lightly dust them with flour.

3. Melt 150 g dark chocolate and 100 g butter together until smooth.

4. In a bowl, whisk 2 eggs, 2 egg yolks, and ½ cup sugar until light and fluffy.

5. Add 1 tsp vanilla extract to the egg mixture.

6. Fold the melted chocolate mixture into the eggs.

7. Add ¼ cup all-purpose flour and a pinch of salt. Mix gently until smooth.

8. Divide the batter equally among the prepared ramekins.

9. Bake for 12–14 minutes until the edges are set but the center remains soft.

10. Let the cakes rest for 2 minutes before carefully unmolding.

11. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

name: Tiramisu
description: Tiramisu is a classic Italian dessert made with layers of coffee-soaked ladyfinger biscuits, creamy mascarpone filling, and a generous dusting of cocoa powder. It is rich, creamy, and served chilled.
ingredients:
Ladyfinger Biscuits
Mascarpone Cheese
Heavy Cream
Sugar
Coffee
Cocoa Powder
Vanilla Extract
instructions:
1. Brew 1 cup strong coffee and allow it to cool completely.

2. Whip 1 cup heavy cream until soft peaks form.

3. In another bowl, beat 250 g mascarpone cheese with ½ cup sugar and 1 tsp vanilla extract until smooth.

4. Fold the whipped cream into the mascarpone mixture.

5. Quickly dip each ladyfinger biscuit into the cooled coffee.

6. Arrange one layer of soaked biscuits in a serving dish.

7. Spread half of the mascarpone mixture evenly over the biscuits.

8. Repeat another layer of coffee-soaked biscuits and mascarpone cream.

9. Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.

10. Dust generously with cocoa powder before serving.

name: Gulab Jamun
description: Gulab Jamun is a traditional Indian dessert made from soft milk-solid dough balls deep-fried until golden and soaked in fragrant sugar syrup flavored with cardamom and rose water.
ingredients:
Milk Powder
All-Purpose Flour
Baking Powder
Milk
Ghee
Sugar
Water
Cardamom
Rose Water
Cooking Oil
instructions:
1. Mix 2 cups milk powder, ½ cup all-purpose flour, and 1 tsp baking powder.

2. Add 2 tbsp ghee and gradually pour in ½ cup milk to form a soft dough.

3. Divide the dough into small smooth balls without cracks.

4. Heat enough cooking oil over low-medium heat.

5. Fry the balls slowly until they become evenly golden brown.

6. In another pan, boil 2 cups sugar with 2 cups water for 8–10 minutes.

7. Add 4 crushed cardamom pods and 1 tsp rose water to the syrup.

8. Transfer the hot fried jamuns directly into the warm syrup.

9. Let them soak for at least 2 hours.

10. Serve warm or chilled.

name: Cheesecake
description: Cheesecake is a creamy and smooth dessert with a buttery biscuit crust and a rich cream cheese filling. It is baked until perfectly set and chilled before serving.
ingredients:
Digestive Biscuits
Butter
Cream Cheese
Sugar
Eggs
Heavy Cream
Vanilla Extract
Lemon Juice
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 160°C.

2. Crush 200 g digestive biscuits into fine crumbs.

3. Mix the crumbs with 100 g melted butter and press firmly into a springform pan.

4. Bake the crust for 10 minutes and allow it to cool.

5. Beat 500 g cream cheese with 1 cup sugar until smooth.

6. Add 2 eggs one at a time, mixing gently after each addition.

7. Add ½ cup heavy cream, 1 tsp vanilla extract, and 1 tbsp lemon juice.

8. Pour the filling over the cooled crust.

9. Bake for 50–55 minutes until the center is slightly set.

10. Cool completely and refrigerate for at least 6 hours before serving.

name: Crème Brûlée
description: Crème Brûlée is a classic French dessert featuring a rich vanilla custard topped with a crisp layer of caramelized sugar. The contrast between the creamy custard and crunchy topping makes it a timeless favorite.
ingredients:
Heavy Cream
Egg Yolks
Sugar
Vanilla Bean
Salt
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 150°C.

2. Heat 2 cups heavy cream with 1 split vanilla bean until just warm.

3. In a bowl, whisk 5 egg yolks with ½ cup sugar until smooth.

4. Slowly pour the warm cream into the egg mixture while whisking continuously.

5. Add a pinch of salt and mix well.

6. Strain the mixture into ramekins.

7. Place the ramekins in a baking tray filled halfway with hot water.

8. Bake for 35–40 minutes until the custard is just set.

9. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours.

10. Sprinkle 1 tbsp sugar over each custard and caramelize using a kitchen torch before serving.

name: Baked Fish with Lemon Butter Sauce
description: Baked Fish with Lemon Butter Sauce is a light and flavorful continental dish featuring tender fish fillets baked with herbs and topped with a rich lemon butter sauce. It is perfect for a healthy lunch or dinner.
ingredients:
Fish Fillet
Butter
Lemon
Garlic
Olive Oil
Parsley
Mixed Herbs
Black Pepper
Salt
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 190°C.

2. Place 2 fish fillets on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.

3. Drizzle 2 tbsp olive oil over the fish.

4. Season with 1 tsp mixed herbs, ½ tsp black pepper, and 1 tsp salt.

5. Bake for 18–20 minutes until the fish flakes easily with a fork.

6. Melt 3 tbsp butter in a saucepan.

7. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and cook for 1 minute.

8. Stir in the juice of 1 lemon and 1 tbsp chopped parsley.

9. Pour the lemon butter sauce over the baked fish.

10. Serve immediately with steamed vegetables or rice.

name: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy Mushroom Risotto is a classic continental rice dish made by slowly cooking Arborio rice with mushrooms, butter, cheese, and vegetable stock until rich and creamy.
ingredients:
Arborio Rice
Mushrooms
Onion
Garlic
Butter
Olive Oil
Vegetable Stock
Parmesan Cheese
Black Pepper
Salt
Parsley
instructions:
1. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a pan.

2. Add 1 chopped onion and 2 minced garlic cloves. Cook for 3 minutes.

3. Add 250 g sliced mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.

4. Stir in 1½ cups Arborio rice and cook for 2 minutes.

5. Add ½ cup hot vegetable stock and stir continuously until absorbed.

6. Continue adding the remaining 4 cups vegetable stock little by little while stirring.

7. Cook for about 20 minutes until the rice is creamy and tender.

8. Stir in ½ cup grated Parmesan cheese.

9. Add ½ tsp black pepper and salt to taste.

10. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.

name: Chicken Cordon Bleu
description: Chicken Cordon Bleu is a popular continental dish made by stuffing chicken breasts with ham and cheese, coating them in breadcrumbs, and baking until crispy and golden.
ingredients:
Chicken Breast
Ham
Swiss Cheese
Egg
All-Purpose Flour
Bread Crumbs
Butter
Black Pepper
Salt
Cooking Oil
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 190°C.

2. Slice 2 chicken breasts horizontally to create a pocket.

3. Stuff each chicken breast with 2 slices of ham and 2 slices of Swiss cheese.

4. Secure the edges with toothpicks.

5. Coat each chicken breast with ½ cup all-purpose flour.

6. Dip into 2 beaten eggs.

7. Coat evenly with 1 cup bread crumbs.

8. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil and lightly brown the chicken for 2 minutes on each side.

9. Transfer to a baking tray and bake for 25–30 minutes.

10. Rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Stuffed Bell Peppers are colorful capsicums filled with seasoned rice, vegetables, cheese, and herbs, then baked until tender. They make a wholesome and nutritious continental meal.
ingredients:
Bell Pepper
Rice
Onion
Garlic
Tomato
Sweet Corn
Mozzarella Cheese
Olive Oil
Italian Seasoning
Black Pepper
Salt
Parsley
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 180°C.

2. Cut the tops off 4 bell peppers and remove the seeds.

3. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan.

4. Cook 1 chopped onion and 2 minced garlic cloves for 3 minutes.

5. Add 1 chopped tomato and ½ cup sweet corn. Cook for 5 minutes.

6. Add 2 cups cooked rice, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, ½ tsp black pepper, and salt to taste.

7. Fill each bell pepper with the rice mixture.

8. Sprinkle 1 cup grated mozzarella cheese on top.

9. Bake for 25–30 minutes until the peppers are tender.

10. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

name: Beef Stroganoff
description: Beef Stroganoff is a classic continental dish made with tender strips of beef cooked in a creamy mushroom sauce and served over buttered noodles or mashed potatoes.
ingredients:
Beef
Mushrooms
Onion
Garlic
Butter
Olive Oil
Fresh Cream
Beef Stock
All-Purpose Flour
Black Pepper
Salt
Parsley
instructions:
1. Slice 500 g beef into thin strips.

2. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a pan.

3. Cook the beef for 4–5 minutes until browned. Remove and keep aside.

4. Add 1 chopped onion, 2 minced garlic cloves, and 250 g sliced mushrooms. Cook for 5 minutes.

5. Stir in 1 tbsp all-purpose flour and cook for 1 minute.

6. Pour in 1 cup beef stock while stirring continuously.

7. Add ½ cup fresh cream and mix well.

8. Return the cooked beef to the pan and simmer for 10 minutes.

9. Season with ½ tsp black pepper and salt to taste.

10. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot with buttered noodles or mashed potatoes.

name: Shepherd's Pie
description: Shepherd's Pie is a classic continental comfort dish made with a savory minced meat filling topped with creamy mashed potatoes and baked until golden brown.
ingredients:
Minced Lamb
Potatoes
Onion
Carrot
Green Peas
Garlic
Butter
Milk
Beef Stock
Tomato Paste
Olive Oil
Salt
Black Pepper
Parsley
instructions:
1. Peel and boil 4 medium potatoes for 20 minutes until tender.

2. Mash the potatoes with 2 tbsp butter and ½ cup warm milk until smooth.

3. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan.

4. Cook 1 chopped onion, 2 minced garlic cloves, and 1 chopped carrot for 5 minutes.

5. Add 500 g minced lamb and cook until browned.

6. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and 1 cup beef stock.

7. Add ½ cup green peas, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes.

8. Transfer the meat mixture to a baking dish.

9. Spread the mashed potatoes evenly over the meat.

10. Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until the top is golden.

11. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

name: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
description: Chicken Alfredo Pasta is a creamy continental pasta dish made with grilled chicken, fettuccine, Parmesan cheese, and a rich garlic cream sauce.
ingredients:
Fettuccine Pasta
Chicken Breast
Butter
Garlic
Fresh Cream
Parmesan Cheese
Olive Oil
Black Pepper
Salt
Parsley
instructions:
1. Cook 250 g fettuccine pasta according to package instructions. Drain and keep aside.

2. Season 2 chicken breasts with salt and black pepper.

3. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil and cook the chicken for 6–7 minutes on each side. Slice into strips.

4. Melt 2 tbsp butter in a pan.

5. Add 3 minced garlic cloves and cook for 1 minute.

6. Pour in 1½ cups fresh cream and simmer for 3 minutes.

7. Add 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese and stir until smooth.

8. Add the cooked pasta and mix well.

9. Top with sliced grilled chicken.

10. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.

name: Ratatouille
description: Ratatouille is a traditional continental vegetable dish made by layering fresh vegetables with herbs and baking them in a rich tomato sauce until tender.
ingredients:
Zucchini
Eggplant
Tomato
Bell Pepper
Onion
Garlic
Olive Oil
Tomato Puree
Mixed Herbs
Salt
Black Pepper
Fresh Basil
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 180°C.

2. Slice 2 zucchini, 1 eggplant, and 3 tomatoes into thin rounds.

3. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan.

4. Cook 1 chopped onion and 3 minced garlic cloves for 3 minutes.

5. Add 1 cup tomato puree, 1 tsp mixed herbs, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes.

6. Spread the tomato sauce in a baking dish.

7. Arrange the sliced vegetables alternately over the sauce.

8. Drizzle 2 tbsp olive oil over the vegetables.

9. Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes.

10. Remove the foil and bake for another 15 minutes.

11. Garnish with fresh basil and serve hot.

name: Pork Chops with Apple Sauce
description: Pork Chops with Apple Sauce is a traditional continental main course featuring juicy pan-seared pork chops served with a sweet and tangy homemade apple sauce.
ingredients:
Pork Chops
Apple
Butter
Brown Sugar
Lemon Juice
Olive Oil
Cinnamon Powder
Salt
Black Pepper
instructions:
1. Season 2 pork chops with 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp black pepper.

2. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet.

3. Cook the pork chops for 5–6 minutes on each side until fully cooked.

4. In another saucepan, melt 2 tbsp butter.

5. Add 2 peeled and chopped apples.

6. Add 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp lemon juice, and ¼ tsp cinnamon powder.

7. Cook for 10–12 minutes until the apples become soft.

8. Mash the apples into a smooth sauce.

9. Serve the pork chops topped with the warm apple sauce.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni
description: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni is a comforting continental baked pasta dish filled with creamy ricotta cheese and spinach, covered with tomato sauce and melted cheese.
ingredients:
Cannelloni Pasta
Spinach
Ricotta Cheese
Mozzarella Cheese
Parmesan Cheese
Tomato Puree
Garlic
Onion
Olive Oil
Mixed Herbs
Salt
Black Pepper
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 180°C.

2. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan.

3. Cook 1 chopped onion and 2 minced garlic cloves for 3 minutes.

4. Add 2 cups chopped spinach and cook until wilted.

5. Mix the spinach with 1½ cups ricotta cheese, salt, and black pepper.

6. Stuff the mixture into 10 cannelloni tubes.

7. Spread 1 cup tomato puree in a baking dish.

8. Arrange the stuffed cannelloni over the sauce.

9. Pour another 1 cup tomato puree over the pasta.

10. Sprinkle 1 cup mozzarella cheese and ½ cup Parmesan cheese on top.

11. Bake for 35–40 minutes until golden and bubbling.

12. Serve hot.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Mango Sticky Rice is a traditional Thai dessert made with sweet sticky rice, creamy coconut milk, and ripe mango slices. It is one of Thailand's most popular desserts.
ingredients:
Sticky Rice
Coconut Milk
Sugar
Salt
Ripe Mango
Sesame Seeds
instructions:
1. Soak 2 cups sticky rice in water for at least 4 hours.

2. Steam the rice for 25–30 minutes until tender.

3. Heat 1½ cups coconut milk in a saucepan.

4. Add ½ cup sugar and ½ tsp salt. Stir until dissolved.

5. Pour half of the coconut mixture over the cooked rice.

6. Let the rice absorb the coconut milk for 20 minutes.

7. Peel and slice 2 ripe mangoes.

8. Serve the sticky rice with the mango slices.

9. Drizzle the remaining coconut sauce over the rice.

10. Sprinkle 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds before serving.

name: Tom Yum Soup
description: Tom Yum Soup is a famous Thai hot and sour soup made with shrimp, mushrooms, aromatic herbs, and a flavorful broth. It is refreshing, spicy, and packed with bold flavors.
ingredients:
Shrimp
Mushrooms
Lemongrass
Galangal
Kaffir Lime Leaves
Garlic
Thai Red Chilli
Fish Sauce
Lime
Chicken Stock
Coriander Leaves
instructions:
1. Bring 4 cups chicken stock to a boil.

2. Add 2 stalks crushed lemongrass, 5 kaffir lime leaves, 1 inch sliced galangal, and 3 crushed garlic cloves.

3. Simmer for 10 minutes.

4. Add 200 g shrimp and 1 cup sliced mushrooms.

5. Cook for 4–5 minutes until the shrimp are fully cooked.

6. Add 2 tbsp fish sauce and the juice of 2 limes.

7. Add 2 chopped Thai red chillies.

8. Simmer for 2 minutes.

9. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves.

10. Serve hot.

name: Thai Basil Fried Rice
description: Thai Basil Fried Rice is a fragrant Thai rice dish stir-fried with vegetables, garlic, basil, and flavorful sauces. It is a quick and satisfying meal perfect for lunch or dinner.
ingredients:
Cooked Rice
Chicken
Garlic
Onion
Bell Pepper
Thai Basil
Egg
Soy Sauce
Fish Sauce
Oyster Sauce
Cooking Oil
Black Pepper
instructions:
1. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wok.

2. Add 3 minced garlic cloves and cook for 30 seconds.

3. Add 200 g diced chicken and cook until lightly browned.

4. Add 1 sliced onion and 1 sliced bell pepper. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.

5. Push the ingredients aside and scramble 1 egg in the wok.

6. Add 3 cups cooked rice and mix well.

7. Add 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 1 tbsp oyster sauce.

8. Stir-fry for 3–4 minutes.

9. Add 1 cup Thai basil leaves and cook for another minute until wilted.

10. Season with black pepper and serve hot.

name: Chilaquiles
description: Chilaquiles is a traditional Mexican breakfast made with crispy tortilla chips simmered in salsa and topped with cheese, eggs, and fresh garnishes. It is a flavorful and hearty way to start the day.
ingredients:
Tortilla Chips
Eggs
Tomato Salsa
Onion
Garlic
Cheddar Cheese
Fresh Coriander
Sour Cream
Cooking Oil
Salt
Black Pepper
instructions:
1. Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a pan over medium heat.

2. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and cook for 30 seconds.

3. Pour in 1½ cups tomato salsa and simmer for 5 minutes.

4. Add 3 cups tortilla chips and gently toss until coated.

5. Cook for 2 minutes until slightly softened.

6. Fry 2 eggs in another pan until cooked to your preference.

7. Transfer the tortilla mixture to a serving plate.

8. Top with the fried eggs.

9. Sprinkle ½ cup grated cheddar cheese.

10. Garnish with sliced onion, chopped coriander, and 2 tbsp sour cream.

11. Serve immediately.

name: Pad See Ew
description: Pad See Ew is a popular Thai stir-fried noodle dish made with wide rice noodles, vegetables, soy sauce, and tender chicken. It has a smoky flavor and is a favorite street food in Thailand.
ingredients:
Wide Rice Noodles
Chicken
Egg
Chinese Broccoli
Garlic
Soy Sauce
Dark Soy Sauce
Oyster Sauce
Sugar
Cooking Oil
White Pepper
instructions:
1. Soak 200 g wide rice noodles according to the package instructions.

2. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wok.

3. Add 3 minced garlic cloves and cook for 30 seconds.

4. Add 200 g sliced chicken and cook until browned.

5. Push the chicken aside and scramble 1 egg.

6. Add the noodles and 1 cup chopped Chinese broccoli.

7. Mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp dark soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, and 1 tsp sugar.

8. Pour the sauce over the noodles.

9. Stir-fry for 4–5 minutes over high heat.

10. Season with white pepper and serve hot.

name: Crab Rangoon
description: Crab Rangoon is a crispy Chinese-American snack made with wonton wrappers filled with a creamy mixture of crab meat and cream cheese, then deep-fried until golden.
ingredients:
Wonton Wrappers
Crab Meat
Cream Cheese
Spring Onion
Garlic Powder
Salt
Black Pepper
Egg
Cooking Oil
instructions:
1. Mix 200 g cream cheese, 100 g crab meat, 2 tbsp chopped spring onion, ½ tsp garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.

2. Place 1 tbsp filling in the center of each wonton wrapper.

3. Beat 1 egg and brush the edges of the wrapper.

4. Fold and seal tightly.

5. Heat enough cooking oil for deep frying.

6. Fry the wontons in batches for 3–4 minutes until golden brown.

7. Remove and drain on paper towels.

8. Serve hot with sweet chili sauce.

name: Tres Leches Cake
description: Tres Leches Cake is a famous Mexican dessert made from a light sponge cake soaked in three kinds of milk and topped with whipped cream. It is incredibly moist, soft, and delicious.
ingredients:
All-Purpose Flour
Eggs
Sugar
Baking Powder
Milk
Condensed Milk
Evaporated Milk
Heavy Cream
Vanilla Extract
Whipped Cream
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 180°C.

2. Beat 4 eggs with 1 cup sugar until fluffy.

3. Add 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, and 1 tsp vanilla extract.

4. Pour the batter into a greased baking pan.

5. Bake for 30 minutes.

6. Allow the cake to cool completely.

7. Mix 1 cup milk, 1 cup condensed milk, and 1 cup evaporated milk.

8. Poke holes all over the cake with a fork.

9. Pour the milk mixture slowly over the cake.

10. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours.

11. Spread whipped cream over the top before serving.

name: Massaman Curry
description: Massaman Curry is a rich and mildly spiced Thai curry made with tender chicken, potatoes, peanuts, and coconut milk. It combines Thai and Indian influences and is best served with steamed rice.
ingredients:
Chicken
Potato
Onion
Massaman Curry Paste
Coconut Milk
Peanuts
Fish Sauce
Brown Sugar
Cooking Oil
Jasmine Rice
instructions:
1. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a saucepan.

2. Add 3 tbsp Massaman curry paste and cook for 2 minutes.

3. Pour in 2 cups coconut milk and stir well.

4. Add 400 g chicken pieces and cook for 10 minutes.

5. Add 2 diced potatoes and 1 sliced onion.

6. Simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.

7. Stir in 2 tbsp roasted peanuts.

8. Add 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tsp brown sugar.

9. Cook for another 5 minutes.

10. Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.

name: Huevos Rancheros
description: Huevos Rancheros is a traditional Mexican breakfast consisting of fried eggs served on warm tortillas and topped with a flavorful tomato salsa. It is a hearty and satisfying breakfast enjoyed throughout Mexico.
ingredients:
Eggs
Corn Tortillas
Tomatoes
Onion
Garlic
Jalapeno
Fresh Coriander
Cooking Oil
Salt
Black Pepper
instructions:
1. Heat 1 tbsp cooking oil in a pan.

2. Add 1 chopped onion and 2 minced garlic cloves. Cook for 2 minutes.

3. Add 3 chopped tomatoes and 1 chopped jalapeno. Cook for 8 minutes until thick.

4. Season the salsa with salt and black pepper.

5. Warm 2 corn tortillas in a pan.

6. Fry 2 eggs until cooked to your preference.

7. Place the tortillas on a serving plate.

8. Top each tortilla with a fried egg.

9. Spoon the tomato salsa over the eggs.

10. Garnish with chopped fresh coriander and serve immediately.

name: Pineapple Fried Rice
description: Pineapple Fried Rice is a colorful Thai dish made with fragrant jasmine rice, vegetables, pineapple, and aromatic seasonings. The combination of sweet pineapple and savory rice makes it a unique and delicious meal.
ingredients:
Cooked Jasmine Rice
Pineapple
Carrot
Green Peas
Onion
Garlic
Egg
Soy Sauce
Curry Powder
Cashews
Spring Onion
Cooking Oil
Salt
instructions:
1. Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a wok.

2. Add 3 minced garlic cloves and 1 chopped onion. Cook for 2 minutes.

3. Add ½ cup diced carrot and ½ cup green peas. Stir-fry for 4 minutes.

4. Push the vegetables aside and scramble 1 egg.

5. Add 3 cups cooked jasmine rice and mix well.

6. Add 1 cup pineapple chunks and ¼ cup roasted cashews.

7. Season with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp curry powder, and salt to taste.

8. Stir-fry for another 3 minutes.

9. Garnish with chopped spring onion.

10. Serve hot.

name: Sesame Balls (Jian Dui)
description: Sesame Balls are a popular Chinese dessert made from glutinous rice flour filled with sweet red bean paste and coated with sesame seeds before deep-frying until golden and crispy.
ingredients:
Glutinous Rice Flour
Red Bean Paste
Sesame Seeds
Sugar
Water
Cooking Oil
instructions:
1. Mix 2 cups glutinous rice flour with ¾ cup warm water and 2 tbsp sugar to form a soft dough.

2. Divide the dough into equal portions.

3. Flatten each portion and place 1 tsp red bean paste in the center.

4. Seal the dough and roll into smooth balls.

5. Coat each ball evenly with sesame seeds.

6. Heat enough cooking oil over medium-low heat.

7. Fry the sesame balls for 8–10 minutes until golden and puffed.

8. Drain on paper towels.

9. Cool slightly before serving.

name: Chicken Satay
description: Chicken Satay is a famous Thai snack made with marinated chicken skewers grilled until juicy and lightly charred. It is traditionally served with a rich peanut dipping sauce.
ingredients:
Chicken Breast
Coconut Milk
Garlic
Ginger
Turmeric Powder
Soy Sauce
Brown Sugar
Peanut Butter
Peanuts
Lime
Cooking Oil
Salt
instructions:
1. Cut 400 g chicken breast into thin strips.

2. Mix ½ cup coconut milk, 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp turmeric powder, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp brown sugar, and salt.

3. Marinate the chicken for 1 hour.

4. Thread the chicken onto soaked wooden skewers.

5. Grill for 4–5 minutes on each side until cooked.

6. In a saucepan, mix ¼ cup peanut butter, 2 tbsp crushed peanuts, ¼ cup coconut milk, and 1 tbsp lime juice.

7. Cook the sauce for 3–4 minutes until smooth.

8. Serve the grilled chicken with the warm peanut sauce.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
description: Sweet and Sour Pork is a classic Chinese dish featuring crispy pork pieces coated in a tangy sweet-and-sour sauce with colorful vegetables. It is a popular restaurant-style dinner served with steamed rice.
ingredients:
Pork
Corn Flour
All-Purpose Flour
Egg
Bell Pepper
Onion
Pineapple
Garlic
Tomato Ketchup
Vinegar
Soy Sauce
Sugar
Cooking Oil
Salt
instructions:
1. Cut 500 g pork into bite-sized pieces.

2. Coat the pork with ½ cup corn flour, ¼ cup all-purpose flour, 1 beaten egg, and salt.

3. Heat enough cooking oil and fry the pork until golden brown. Remove and keep aside.

4. Heat 1 tbsp oil in another pan.

5. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and cook for 30 seconds.

6. Add 1 chopped onion, 1 chopped bell pepper, and 1 cup pineapple chunks. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.

7. Mix 3 tbsp tomato ketchup, 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and 2 tbsp sugar.

8. Pour the sauce into the pan and cook for 2 minutes.

9. Add the fried pork and toss until evenly coated.

10. Serve hot with steamed rice.
